description: A link to the free in-browser 3D mockup editor on a product and scene, with a preview image. The person drops in their design, turns it, changes light and scene, animates it, and exports a free 1080 px image, or a 4K image or MP4 video for $3.

scene.description: Optional. Not every product has every scene; the product's default scene is used when it has not.

name: mockup_link
title: Open the live 3D mockup editor
